Search the whole Bonnyrigg Tiles range

Who it is for

What trade and DIY customers pick up here

Tilers and builders use this range to load a job in one stop, and DIY renovators use it to buy what their tiler has asked for. It covers a tiler's supplies list from the first primer to the last bead of silicone.

What do you need for a tiling job, stage by stage?

StageWhat it doesWhere to find it
1. PrepareLevel and prime the surface so the adhesive bondsPrimers and self levelling compound, with the grout and additives
2. WaterproofSeal wet areas before any tile goes downLiquid membranes
3. FixBed the tile on the right adhesive, set out with spacers and trimsAdhesives, trims, trowels and spacers
4. GroutFill the joints and seal the cornersGrout, silicone and grouting tools
5. Seal and cleanRemove grout haze, then seal grout or stone if it needs itSealers and cleaners

A general guide to the order of a tiling job. Your tiler and each product data sheet set the detail.

Wet areas start with waterproofing supplies and finish with silicone sealant in the corners. Tile trims and angles protect exposed edges, and grout sealers and tile cleaners deal with haze and stains once the job is grouted. For the work itself there are tiling tools and electric cement mixers.

If you are comparing tile supplies in Sydney, the advantage here is simple: the tile and everything that goes under, between and around it can go on one enquiry.

Fixing products

Adhesives, grout, sand and cement

Start with the tile adhesive for your tile and surface, then choose a tile grout colour to suit. For screeds, tile beds and brickwork, see our Sydney sand and cement mixes.

Not sure which adhesive suits a large format porcelain or which grout suits a narrow joint? Read our adhesive and grout guide or ask the team.

Collecting

Pick-up from Bonnyrigg, with stock confirmed first

Call or send an enquiry with what you need and how many, and the team checks what is available before you drive over. The showroom opens at 7am Monday to Saturday.

Ordering tiles as well? Put the supplies on the same enquiry so they are collected or delivered together.

Pricing

Prices for trade and DIY

128 of the 218 products show their price on this site, from $5 to $5,800. Where a product comes in several sizes, the card shows the starting price. The BAT Trims profiles show Enquire Now, and our team confirms those prices when you enquire.

Buying for a large job or buying regularly? Talk to the team in the showroom about your order.

Loading

Loading your ute or trailer

Bags of adhesive, cement and sand add up quickly: twenty 20 kg bags is 400 kg before the tiles go on. Check what your vehicle can carry, and read our vehicle loading policy before you come.

Sand is self service. The bags need to be filled when you collect, so allow a little extra time.

Paperwork

Product warranties and data sheets

Each product carries its maker's own warranty, and the warranty depends on the product being used as its data sheet describes. Data sheets set out mixing, coverage, curing times and which surfaces a product suits.

Ask us for the data sheet of anything on this page before you buy, and keep it with the job records.

Where we are

South West Sydney and beyond

The showroom is in Bonnyrigg, a short drive from Fairfield, Cabramatta, Liverpool, Wetherill Park and Smithfield. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. We deliver across Sydney metro.

We open at 7am, Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm, so trades can load before heading to site.

Brands

Sika, Davco, Laticrete, ASA and more

The range is built on trade brands: BAT Trims, Amark, Sika, Spirit, Aqua Mix, Davco, Boral, Soudal, Laticrete and Maxisil. Each product page names the maker, so you can match what your tiler has specified.

Bonnyrigg Tiles is family-owned and under current management since 2017.

Sizes

Bag sizes and coverage

Powder adhesives on this range come in 13.5 kg, 15 kg and 20 kg bags, grout from 1.5 kg to 20 kg, cement in 20 kg bags and sand in 25 kg bags. Liquids such as primers, membranes and sealers run from under a litre to 20 litre pails.

Coverage depends on the product, the trowel and the surface, so use the figure printed on the bag or data sheet when you work out how many you need.

Storage

Storing bags and buckets

Keep bagged cement, adhesive and grout off the ground, under cover and away from damp. Once a bag has drawn moisture it sets in lumps and should not be used.

Store liquids with the lid sealed, out of direct sun and above freezing, and check the use-by date before you open an old pail.

Trade supplies

Trade supplies questions

Do you sell tiling supplies to the public?

Yes. Anyone can buy tiling supplies from Bonnyrigg Tiles, trade or DIY. Add products to an enquiry on this site or come to the showroom.

Can I get trade pricing?

The prices on this site are our listed prices. If you are buying for a large job or buying regularly, talk to the team in the showroom or call (02) 8786 0288 about your order.

What brands of tile adhesive do you stock?

The tile adhesives on our range are from Sika, Laticrete and Davco. Each one is listed with its price on the tile adhesive page.

Can I pick up sand and cement today?

Call (02) 8786 0288 first and the team will check what is available. Sand is self service, so the bags are filled when you collect.

Do you deliver trade supplies to site?

We deliver across Sydney metro. Tell us what you need and the site address when you enquire, and the team will confirm delivery for bagged and bulky products.

Where are you in South West Sydney?

In Bonnyrigg. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. We are open Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm, and closed on Sundays.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Anyone can buy tiling supplies from Bonnyrigg Tiles, trade or DIY. Add products to an enquiry on this site or come to the showroom.
The prices on this site are our listed prices. If you are buying for a large job or buying regularly, talk to the team in the showroom or call (02) 8786 0288 about your order.

mainEntity.name: What brands of tile adhesive do you stock?

acceptedAnswer.text: The tile adhesives on our range are from Sika, Laticrete and Davco. Each one is listed with its price on the tile adhesive page.

mainEntity.name: Can I pick up sand and cement today?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call (02) 8786 0288 first and the team will check what is available. Sand is self service, so the bags are filled when you collect.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver trade supplies to site?

acceptedAnswer.text: We deliver across Sydney metro. Tell us what you need and the site address when you enquire, and the team will confirm delivery for bagged and bulky products.

mainEntity.name: Where are you in South West Sydney?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Bonnyrigg. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. We are open Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm, and closed on Sundays.
